parameters.name: AuthenticationMethod
parameters.description: The authentication method. Currently, only ClientKey is supported.

parameters.name: Policies
parameters.description:
The permission policy.

> You can bind up to three permission policies to each AAP.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms create-application-access-point --name aap_test --description aap_description --authentication-method ClientKey --policies kst-hzz62ee817bvyyr5x0000.efkd_,_kst-hzz62ee817bvyyr5x0000.eyyp --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms CreateApplicationAccessPoint --region cn-hangzhou --Description aap_description --Policies 'kst-hzz62ee817bvyyr5x0000.efkd_,_kst-hzz62ee817bvyyr5x0000.eyyp' --AuthenticationMethod ClientKey --Name aap_test
